votes.motion: Councilor Albrecht moved to adjourn into a Closed session to discuss the     purchase, exchange, or lease of real property; and to discuss the character, performance or     competence of an individual. Councilor Koivisto seconded the motion.
Consideration of Resolution #2023-13 approving an agreement between Lehi City and Brightview Landscape Services for parks and detention mowing services.

Consideration of Preliminary subdivision approval for the Fox Canyon Plats A1 and I1 including 41 single family lots located at approximately 5400 North Fox Canyon Road with the Flex Land Use Designations in the Traverse Mountain Planned Community. Items 6 and 7 were heard simultaneously. Mayor Johnson asked for a motion to untable items

Councilor Koivisto amended her motion to include Councilor Hancock’s     and Mayor Johnson’s comments. Councilor Albrecht stated that she would like to have a plan for the traffic signal moving     forward and also noted that the applicant may entertain some changes if it were to come back.

Consideration of Ordinance #21-2023 the Arias General Plan Amendment on 1.97 acres of property located at 7944 N 9550 W (approximately 2300 West Pioneer Crossing), changing the land use designation from Neighborhood Commercial to Heavy Commercial.

Consideration of Ordinance #22-2023 the Marwood zone change on 0.84-acres of property located at 301 East State, changing the zoning from Mixed Use to TOD. Items 9 and 10 were heard together. The applicant was not present. Mr. Struthers stated that they have concerns with the access points that was not addressed in the Development Review
